# Monthly sculpt challenge themes, one per line, used in order (month 1 = first line after the start month,
# wrapping around). Format: Theme | one-line prompt. Add, reorder or replace lines any time; lines starting with #
# are ignored.
Creature Bust | Design a creature head and shoulders: anatomy that could really breathe.
Stylized Hero | A character with big, readable shapes. Think animation, not photo.
Ancient Relic | A carved artifact with wear, cracks and history.
Skull Study | Any skull, real or invented. Focus on planes and structure.
Tiny Monster | Something small and adorable that could still bite.
Armored Knight | Hard-surface meets organic: plates, straps and the person underneath.
Sea Creature | From the deep: tentacles, scales, shells or something new.
Portrait of a Stranger | A human face with character: age, mood and story.
Dragon | Head, full body or just an eye. Make it yours.
Robot With Feelings | Mechanical, but expressive.
Mythical Beast | Pick a myth from anywhere in the world and reimagine it.
Your Pet as a Hero | Your pet (or a friend's), heroic proportions encouraged.
